items.t: Jumia Technologies Q3: Untimely Resurgence Of Macroeconomic Pressures
items.sum: Analyst rates Jumia a Hold: 2026 GMV growth guidance is cut to 16%-18%, with a $31M-$35M adjusted EBITDA loss expected and 2027 outlook pending.

items.t: RBC Capital Maintains Outperform on Jumia Technologies, Lowers Price Target to $4.5
items.sum: RBC Capital analyst Brad Erickson maintains Jumia Technologies (NYSE:JMIA) with a Outperform and lowers the price target from $13 to $4.5.

items.t: Jumia Technologies (JMIA) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut As Growth Outlook Softens
items.sum: Jumia Technologies is in focus after analysts cut fair value from US$11.69 to US$8.56, reflecting a reset in what they think the stock is worth today. This shift lines up with recent research that highlights a mixed setup, as confidence in the marketplace model is weighed against softer growth expectations and wider losses.
